title: Drum
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- drum body -->
  <rect x='26' y='38' width='48' height='36' rx='4' fill='#d94f3d'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <rect x='26' y='38' width='9' height='36' rx='4' fill='#b83a2c'/>
  <!-- zigzag laces -->
  <polyline points='35,46 41,40 47,46 53,40 59,46 65,40 71,46' fill='none' stroke='#f2d16b' stroke-width='3' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polyline points='35,56 41,50 47,56 53,50 59,56 65,50 71,56' fill='none' stroke='#f2d16b' stroke-width='3' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- bottom rim -->
  <rect x='24' y='68' width='52' height='7' rx='3' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <rect x='24' y='68' width='52' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#b07a3e'/>
  <!-- top head (skin) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='26' ry='8' fill='#f6e6c8'/>
  <!-- top rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='26' ry='8' fill='none' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='4'/>
  <!-- drumsticks -->
  <line x1='22' y1='20' x2='42' y2='34' stroke='#c69a5e' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='78' y1='20' x2='58' y2='34' stroke='#c69a5e' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- stick tips -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='34' r='3.5' fill='#f2f0e6'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='3.5' fill='#f2f0e6'/>
  <!-- motion sparkles -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='14' r='2' fill='#ffe27a'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='14' r='2' fill='#ffe27a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='2.5' fill='#ffe27a'/>
</svg>
